The '''Exceed Testing Center''' (Japanese: '''エクシード社のテストセンター''' ''Exceed's Test Center'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location located in [[Johto]]. It is located inside the [[Exceed]] building near [[Mochew City]].

==History==
During ''[[HZ095|The Strong Sphere]]'', the [[Explorers]] used this facility to test and conduct their new product, the [[Strong Sphere]], using {{pkmn|Trainers}} and their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} who want to take part as testing subjects.
